solution:
SELECT s.name, r.score
FROM Student AS s JOIN Result AS r ON s.id = r.student_id
WHERE r.subject = 'Computing' AND r.score >= 50
ORDER BY r.score DESC, s.name ASC;

steps.text: Select each student name and score.
Join students to their results using the student ID.
Keep Computing results of at least 50.
Sort highest scores first; break ties alphabetically.
